question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
WITH movie_years AS (
    SELECT 
        MID,
        TRY_CAST(year AS INTEGER) as yr
    FROM Movie
    WHERE TRY_CAST(year AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
actor_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mc.PID,
        my.yr
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN movie_years my ON mc.MID = my.MID
    WHERE mc.PID IS NOT NULL
),
actor_year_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        PID,
        MIN(yr) as first_year,
        MAX(yr) as last_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT yr) as num_years
    FROM actor_years
    GROUP BY PID
),
actor_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        ay.PID,
        ay.yr,
        LAG(ay.yr) OVER (PARTITION BY ay.PID ORDER BY ay.yr) as prev_year
    FROM actor_years ay
),
actor_max_gap AS (
    SELECT 
        PID,
        MAX(yr - prev_year) as max_gap
    FROM actor_gaps
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actor_count
FROM actor_year_ranges ayr
LEFT JOIN actor_max_gap amg ON ayr.PID = amg.PID
WHERE amg.max_gap IS NULL OR amg.max_gap <= 4
